title: Fact-Check Verdict Artifact
description: Output of the fact-checker subagent. Stored at memory/workspace/{task_id}/fact-check.json. The verdict enum is the CANONICAL producer contract (2026-08-02): consumers (scripts/pipeline/fc_verdict.py, used by both the orchestrator content gate and pre_publish_gate) additionally tolerate legacy aliases on READ, but at WRITE time exactly these four strings are legal — 7 of 338 historical artifacts (2.1%) invented out-of-enum verdicts ('issues_fixed', 'DONE_WITH_CONCERNS', 'BLOCKED - DO NOT PUBLISH') because no schema constrained this field.

verdict.description: CLEAN = publish-ready, nothing fixed. CLEAN_WITH_NOTES = publish-ready after in-place fixes (record them in issues[]/notes[]). FIX_REQUIRED = intermediate, pipeline must fix then re-dispatch. BLOCK_PUBLISH = hard veto.

issues.description: Findings, including in-place corrections recorded for CLEAN_WITH_NOTES.

notes.description: Free-form audit notes (e.g. before/after of an in-place correction).

charts_updated.description: image-prompts.json chart_spec slots updated during correction sync (2026-07-01).
